Is it really free?
Yes. The site is free for players, and there is nothing to buy on it. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. You can play instantly without an account, and there is no newsletter to sign up for either.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All the games, about 7,019 of them, are browser games that play straight away with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category; games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Are the games safe for my kids?
We only allow family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their own progress the same way, so clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose it.
A game will not load. What can I do?

If a game does not start, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is, so we can look into it. Games built for a wide screen may also be waiting for you to turn your phone sideways.
Where do the games come from?

Five games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site. The rest are licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, or sent in directly by independent developers (7 so far). We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will remove it. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can embed the games made by Door 404: each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer embed code for them.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
